brief:
Israeli forces killed 14 people in Gaza over two days, including a six-year-old child, Middle East Eye reported. The deaths occurred despite an ongoing ceasefire in the territory.

A UN commission of inquiry said Israel continues committing genocidal acts, according to the report. Investigators accused Israeli forces of maintaining patterns consistent with genocide even as the ceasefire remains in effect.
dek: Israeli forces kill 14 in Gaza as UN commission says genocide continues Submitted by MEE staff on Tue, 10/27/2026 - 11:34 Six-year-old among those killed in past two days as UN investigators accuse Israel of continuing genocidal acts despite ceasefire…
title: Israeli forces kill 14 in Gaza; UN accuses Israel of genocide
